Architecture

The product layer respects every backend boundary that was already frozen.

Frontend pages consume only the existing REST APIs. They never speak directly to MCP, SimulationService, or EnergyPlus.

Hover or select a component to inspect its responsibility, contract, and boundary.

Interactive Architecture

Frontend

Premium Next.js marketing and workspace surfaces.

Owns product presentation, dashboards, forms, charts, and executive storytelling while consuming only backend HTTP contracts.

Primary Contract

Reads and writes through versioned REST APIs under /api/v1.

Boundary

Never talks directly to MCP, SimulationService, or EnergyPlus.

Presentation Layer

Next.js routes, client components, charts, forms, and motion-based storytelling.

REST Contract

All workspace data flows through the existing versioned FastAPI endpoints.

Execution Stack

The backend continues to own AI execution, simulation orchestration, and report generation.
